tictactoe.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
tictactoe.description: Three in a row against an AI with three difficulties and five personalities. Play matches or watch two AIs battle.
tictactoe.rules:
Take turns placing marks on the 3x3 grid. Three in a row (across, down or diagonal) wins. You are X; the openers alternate between games.

Use the mouse or keys 1-9. Hint shows the best move, Undo takes back your last move.
blackjack.name: Blackjack
blackjack.description: Beat the dealer to 21 with splits, doubles and insurance. Basic-strategy hints and a bankroll leaderboard.
blackjack.rules:
Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Face cards count 10, aces 1 or 11.

Blackjack pays 3:2. The dealer hits soft 17 and checks for blackjack. Insurance costs half your bet and pays 2:1. Split pairs up to four hands; split aces get one card each. Double down on any two cards.

Keys: H hit, S stand, D double, P split, Enter deal.
blackjack.place_bet: Place your bet and press Deal.
blackjack.insurance_offer: Dealer shows an ace. Take insurance?

solitaire.name: Solitaire
solitaire.description: Classic Klondike with draw-one or draw-three, undo, double-click moves and auto-complete.
solitaire.rules:
Build the four foundations up by suit from ace to king.

In the tableau, stack cards down in alternating colours; only a king may fill an empty column. Click the stock to turn cards. Click a card, then a destination, or double-click to send it to the best spot.
solitaire.help: Click a card, then where it should go. Double-click sends it home.
yahtzee.name: Yahtzee
yahtzee.description: Roll five dice up to three times a turn and fill all thirteen boxes. Upper bonus and Yahtzee bonuses included.
yahtzee.rules:
Each turn roll up to three times, holding any dice between rolls, then score one empty box.

Upper boxes score the matching faces; 63 or more earns a 35 point bonus. Three/Four of a kind and Chance score the sum of all dice. Full house 25, small straight 30, large straight 40, Yahtzee 50. Each extra Yahtzee is worth 100 more and can be used as a joker.

Keys: Space roll, 1-5 hold dice.
yahtzee.roll_hint: Roll the dice to start your turn.
yahtzee.hold_hint: Click dice to hold them, roll again, or pick a box.
yahtzee.pick_hint: No rolls left: pick a box to score.
minesweeper.name: Minesweeper
minesweeper.description: Clear the minefield with a safe first click, flags, chording, keyboard controls and best times.
minesweeper.rules:
Reveal every square that isn't a mine. Numbers show how many mines touch that square. Your first click is always safe.

Left click reveals, right click flags. Click a number whose mines are all flagged to open its neighbours. Keyboard: arrows move, Space reveals, F flags.
minesweeper.help: Left click to reveal, right click to flag.
gofish.name: Go Fish
gofish.description: Ask for ranks, fish from the pond and collect books of four against a computer with a memory.
gofish.rules:
Ask the computer for a rank you hold by clicking one of your cards. If it has any, it hands them all over and you go again. If not, go fish: draw from the pond. Drawing the rank you asked for earns another turn.

Four of a kind make a book. Whoever has the most books when all thirteen are made wins.
